statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-26127 (GHSA-73j8-2gch-69rq) is a .NET denial of service issue: decoding malformed Base64Url input causes an out-of-bounds read in the .NET runtime and in Microsoft.Bcl.Memory. Microsoft lists .NET 10 runtime releases before 10.0.4 as affected and 10.0.4 as fixed, on all platforms (https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/384, https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-73j8-2gch-69rq, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.4/10.0.4.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's dotnet/dotnet source release, and each build's version is the .NET release it carries; 10.0.4-r0 is built from the v10.0.104 source tag (https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet/releases/tag/v10.0.104). Checked the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0 through 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64: the shared framework in dotnet10-runtime is Microsoft.NETCore.App 10.0.2 in 10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3 in 10.0.3-r0 and 10.0.4 in 10.0.4-r0, and matches the build's .NET version in every later build, as does the Microsoft.Bcl.Memory NuGet package in dotnet10-runtime-artifacts. The range ends at 10.0.4-r0 because it is the first published build with the fixed runtime.

CVE-2026-26127 (GHSA-73j8-2gch-69rq) is a .NET denial of service issue: an out-of-bounds read when decoding malformed Base64Url input, in the .NET runtime and in Microsoft.Bcl.Memory. Microsoft lists the Linux runtime packs among the affected packages and fixed .NET 9 in 9.0.14 (https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/security/advisories/GHSA-73j8-2gch-69rq, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/384, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.14/9.0.14.md). DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold: the .NET runtime ships in dotnet9-runtime, in the SDK held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap and in the runtime and ILCompiler NuGet packages in dotnet9-runtime-artifacts, and Microsoft.Bcl.Memory.dll ships in the Microsoft.Bcl.Memory NuGet package in dotnet9-runtime-artifacts. In every build, the runtime assemblies read (System.Private.CoreLib.dll and System.Memory.dll) and Microsoft.Bcl.Memory.dll carry that build's .NET version. In 9.0.12-r0 and 9.0.13-r0 they are 9.0.12 and 9.0.13, which are affected; from 9.0.14-r0 on, the version is 9.0.14 or later, with Microsoft's fix. The range ends at 9.0.14-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
